Avoid morning quick deaths, which would eliminate students too. Each fully learned reachable source among these three cuts pool by 4: ~14,000 after one, ~3,400 after two, ~860 after three (caught). Two of five source kinds are inaccessible, fixed but unknown. Starting with three kinds has a 10% chance all three are reachable; otherwise these sources alone remain safe. Plan repeat this selection through first feedback after day 3, then reassess source accessibility using rounded pool. National always safe. Hidden extra reports may prevent traces or create ambiguous constraints, so pool is probabilistic evidence, not certainty. Daily cap 10 quick +2 timed; afternoon quick is feasible. No timed entries needed for 7 kills.
